svg.title: Learnova
svg.desc:
A chalk L between two chevrons, with a gold star on its shoulder.
The colours are the app's own rather than an icon palette invented beside it. #1d1d1d is the dark theme's page, #fdfcdf is its cream, #f5c243 is the supply gold (the same gold as the stars pinned around Round Mode's front door), and #7cc9a6 is the supply mint (the mint on the music toggle and on "for it"). All four are in app/globals.css.
The two chevrons are that one mint at two opacities rather than two different hues. A second colour would have had to come from outside the set the app actually owns, and an icon is where a fifth colour starts looking like it belongs elsewhere too.
The ground is painted rather than left transparent. A favicon sits on whatever the browser's tab strip happens to be, and a cream L on a light tab is an invisible one.
(No XML comments in here: a double hyphen is illegal inside one, and every token name in this app has two.)
